title: Exclusive: The Army's $99M Bet on Rune's Contested Logistics Software | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year Army contract for its TyrOS logistics software platform, making it available across all Army components and joint military partners.
body_markdown:
Tectonic covered Rune Technologies by Barratt Dewey in a piece titled “Exclusive: The Army's $99M Bet on Rune's Contested Logistics Software.” Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year Army contract for its TyrOS logistics software platform, making it available across all Army components and joint military partners.


Read the full article[here](https://www.tectonicdefense.com/exclusive-the-armys-99m-bet-on-runes-contested-logistics-software/) .
